lines: 1807 用電解第一次分離出金屬鈉
1810 確認氯是元素：食鹽 NaCl 的兩種元素都跟他有關
物質由原子組成，同一元素的原子質量相同
化學反應＝原子重新組合，不生也不滅
亞佛加厥原本學法律、當過律師
後來才轉做物理，在杜林大學任教
道耳頓的原子量表（1805 發表）
以氫＝1 當基準，其他元素都跟氫比
CO 和 CO2：同量的碳，配到的氧質量比 1 : 2
道耳頓記了 57 年天氣日誌
留下約 20 萬筆觀測紀錄
沒有證據時先假設 1 : 1 → 水寫成 HO
所以氧的原子量算成 7（今天是 16.00）
1808・給呂薩克：氣體化合體積定律
2 體積氫＋1 體積氧 → 2 體積水蒸氣
道耳頓不相信這組數據
發表後長期被冷落，1860 年才被化學界普遍接受
亞佛加厥本人從沒算過 6.02 × 10²³
1909 法國佩蘭量出數值，提議以他命名
1890 年代才由德國化學家奧士華開始使用
同溫、同壓、同體積的氣體，分子個數相同
氫氣是 H2、氧氣是 O2
一個分子由兩個原子組成；反應時拆開的是分子
2 體積＋1 體積 → 2 體積：用 HO 解釋不了
公克 ÷ 莫耳質量 → 莫耳 → × NA → 個數
公克和個數不能直接換：先換成莫耳
水中 氫 : 氧 質量比約 1 : 8
當成 HO → 氧＝8（道耳頓當年量成 7）
實驗式＝最簡整數比；分子式＝真實個數
甲醛 CH2O・醋酸 C2H4O2・葡萄糖 C6H12O6
實驗式都是 CH2O，要靠莫耳質量才分得出來
1860・卡爾斯魯厄國際化學會議
坎尼扎羅發小冊子，重新介紹亞佛加厥假說
原子量從此統一（亞佛加厥已於 1856 年過世）
只有 18.02 g ≈ 18 mL，大約一大匙

shots.frame: Wide establishing shot from behind the audience: an epic night rap-battle arena - a round raised stage in the centre with a glowing gold ring on its floor, the LEFT half an early-1800s Manchester schoolroom-laboratory (rainy arched windows, a brass barometer, a rack of wooden balls) in deep COBALT-BLUE light, the RIGHT half an Italian baroque hall (stone arches, rows of glass gas jars, small flames) in warm SODIUM-YELLOW light, a DJ booth at the back centre; the student audience in the foreground stand up with hands raised.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the students jump to their feet and cheer with both hands up, light beams sweep across the arena from cobalt blue to sodium yellow, and haze rolls over the stage.

shots.frame: John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, not touching it yet, holding a plain wooden ball the size of an orange up in one hand and studying it, a stern proud stare toward the right, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he turns the wooden ball slowly in his fingers, sets it down on a small stand beside the microphone and steps up to the microphone, mouth closed.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, not touching it yet, holding a small round clear glass flask up to the yellow light, a sly grin toward the left, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he swirls the empty glass flask once, peers through it toward his rival with one eye like a telescope, and sets it down with a grin, mouth closed.

shots.frame: Humphry Davy stands behind his DJ booth at the back centre of the arena stage, black headphones around his neck, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, one hand on a spinning vinyl record, the other hand raised to the crowd, grinning; cobalt-blue light on the left, sodium-yellow light on the right.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he shouts to the crowd with a big confident grin, scratches the record back and forth on the beat, then throws his free arm up toward the crowd.

shots.frame: Face-off on the round stage: John Dalton on the LEFT in cobalt-blue light and Amedeo Avogadro on the RIGHT in sodium-yellow light stand at their chrome microphones facing each other in profile across the glowing gold ring; Dalton glares sternly, Avogadro answers with a sly grin; both mouths closed.
John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, gripping the microphone stand with one hand, chin raised, a stern proud stare, about to rap.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps hard, taps his chest twice with his free hand, then holds up one finger for 'first'.

shots.frame: Flashback, Manchester around 1805: John Dalton in his plain dark-brown Quaker coat stands at the front of a simple wooden schoolroom, holding up a wooden ball in each hand to show a few teenage boys at their desks, rain on the tall window behind him.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he presses the two wooden balls together to show them joining, then holds them apart again; the boys lean forward to look.

shots.frame: Close-up: John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, holding a plain wooden ball up beside his face between two fingers, a stern certain look, blue rim light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly shakes his head while holding the ball still, then closes his fist around it.

shots.frame: Reaction shot: Amedeo Avogadro on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage leans on his chrome microphone stand with his arms crossed, listening with an amused, disdainful little smile, one eyebrow raised.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he slowly shakes his head with an amused smile and raises his eyebrow even higher; his mouth stays closed in a smug, disdainful little smile the whole time; he never speaks.

shots.frame: Flashback, night: John Dalton at a candlelit wooden desk writes in a large notebook with a quill, the open page filled with neat columns of small hand-drawn circle symbols, each circle with a dot, a line or a cross inside, numbers written beside them.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he draws one more small circle with a dot in the middle, writes a number beside it and nods to himself.

shots.frame: John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, one hand raised showing one finger, a strict teacher's face, blue light behind him.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, raises one finger, then two fingers, slowly and clearly, then taps the two fingers on his palm.

shots.frame: Flashback, Manchester around 1810: older John Dalton in a plain dark coat stands on a rainy rooftop terrace beside a brass rain gauge and a barometer on the wall, writing in a small notebook, drizzle falling.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he peers at the rain gauge, writes a number in his notebook, and taps the barometer glass with one finger.

shots.frame: Close-up: John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, holding up a single sheet of paper between two fingers with a scornful look, blue rim light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly crumples the paper in one hand, then drops it with contempt.

shots.frame: Flashback, night, close on a candlelit notebook page: John Dalton's hand with a quill has just written the letters "HO" large and clearly next to two small hand-drawn circles side by side, one circle with a dot inside and one plain circle.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the quill underlines "HO" twice firmly, and the camera pushes in slowly on the page.

shots.frame: John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, holding the flat edge of his hand up like a knife beside a wooden ball on the stand, a mocking frown, blue light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly lowers the edge of his hand toward the ball, stops just above it, and wags one finger 'no'.

shots.frame: Reaction close-up: Amedeo Avogadro in sodium-yellow light covers a silent laugh with one hand, eyes sparkling with mockery, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, his shoulders shake with a silent laugh, he lowers the hand and spreads it in a small 'whatever' shrug; his mouth stays closed in a smug, disdainful little smile the whole time; he never speaks.

shots.frame: Flashback: a forgotten old printed journal lies closed on a high shelf of a dim library in Turin, covered in thick grey dust and cobwebs, a beam of dusty light from a high window; no people.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, dust drifts slowly through the light beam, a spider crawls across the cobweb, and the camera pushes in slowly on the dusty journal.

shots.frame: John Dalton stands at the chrome microphone on the cobalt-blue left side of the stage, pointing across the stage toward the right with a stern scolding finger, blue light flaring behind him.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps harder, shakes the pointing finger slowly twice, then folds his arms.

shots.frame: Flashback, Paris 1909: a French physicist with a short beard and round spectacles in a dark suit looks into a big brass microscope on a wooden lab bench, a lamp and glass slides beside it.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he adjusts the microscope knob, lifts his head, and writes a long number in his notebook with a satisfied look.

shots.frame: Waist-up side-on two-shot, the two men stand close, about one metre apart, both faces large and visible in profile: John Dalton on the LEFT leans toward his rival and holds one flat hand high like the top of a building; Amedeo Avogadro on the RIGHT faces him with arms crossed and a smug amused smile, mouth closed; cobalt-blue light left, sodium-yellow light right.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Dalton raps at Avogadro and slowly raises his flat hand higher, floor by floor; Avogadro keeps his arms firmly crossed the whole time and only smirks, his hands never move.
cons: Amedeo Avogadro on the right keeps his lips pressed together in a smug smile from the first to the last frame; he never opens his mouth.
Avogadro's arms stay crossed over his chest for the whole shot; his hands never move. Dalton's hands move slowly and stay sharp.

shots.frame: Close-up, darker: John Dalton at the microphone turns his head toward the right and looks down his nose with ice-cold eyes, blue light from below, holding the microphone out toward the right side of the frame.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps slowly and coldly, holding the microphone still out toward the right side of the frame; his free hand stays low and still, and on the last word he slowly opens his fingers.
cons: Slow, controlled movements only: both hands stay sharp and clearly shaped, no fast gestures, no motion blur.

shots.frame: Audience B-roll: modern Taiwanese university students in the arena, some in white lab coats, shout 'ohhh' in shock, hands on their heads, some pointing at the stage, cobalt-blue light washing over them.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the students jump and shout with hands on their heads, pointing at the stage.

shots.frame: Close-up: Humphry Davy at his DJ turntables, headphones on, brass goggles on his forehead, one hand on the record, grinning with excitement, white-silver light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he scratches the record fast back and forth and bobs his head, mouth closed in a grin.

shots.frame: Flashback, London 1807: young Humphry Davy in shirtsleeves and brass goggles leans over a lab bench in a dark basement laboratory, touching two metal wires from a tall stack of copper-and-zinc battery plates into a small dish of white molten lump.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, a blinding white spark flashes, tiny bright silver beads burst into small yellow flames on the dish, and Davy jumps back with a delighted laugh.

shots.frame: Humphry Davy behind his DJ booth points firmly toward the sodium-yellow right side of the stage with a big grin, headphones around his neck, mouth closed.
Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, cracking his knuckles, a confident challenging grin toward the left, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he rolls his shoulders, grips the microphone stand with one hand and lifts his chin toward his rival, mouth closed.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, holding up one finger with a cocky grin, about to rap.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, holds up one finger for 'one paper', then points at his rival.

shots.frame: Insert in a modern university chemistry lab: three identical clear party balloons of exactly the same size float side by side, tied to the same clamp stand on a white lab bench; nobody in the shot.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the three identical balloons sway gently together in the air, and the camera pushes in slowly; they stay exactly the same size.

shots.frame: Close-up: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, one hand raised palm-up like weighing evidence, a sharp lawyer's smirk, yellow rim light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly taps two fingers on his open palm like a judge's gavel, then shakes his head.

shots.frame: Reaction close-up: John Dalton in cobalt-blue light grits his teeth behind closed lips, jaw clenched, eyes burning, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, his jaw tightens and he slowly narrows his eyes at his rival; his mouth stays closed.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, holding up both fists pressed together side by side in front of his chest, a sly grin, yellow light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, keeps the two fists pressed together and slowly shows them to the crowd like a pair holding hands.

shots.frame: Close-up: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, his two fists pressed together in front of his chin, a teasing look toward the left, yellow rim light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly pulls the two fists apart, then opens both hands as if to say 'see?'.

shots.frame: Insert in a modern university chemistry lab: on a white lab bench, two identical large glass gas syringes filled with colourless gas stand on the left and one same-size glass gas syringe on the right, all three clamped side by side in a row; nobody in the shot.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the camera slides slowly along the row of three glass gas syringes from left to right.

shots.frame: Flashback, Paris around 1808: a French chemist in a dark coat and white cravat carefully reads the gas level in a tall graduated glass tube standing in a trough of water, other glass tubes and flasks on the bench.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he lifts the tube a little, reads the level at eye height, and nods with a satisfied look.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, singing with eyes half closed, one hand open at his chest, a warm smile, soft yellow light and floating haze.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he sings smoothly, slowly lifts the open hand forward toward the crowd, and sways gently with the melody.

shots.frame: Insert in a modern Taiwanese university classroom: a teacher's hand writes on a green chalkboard, which clearly shows "g → mol → N" with "÷ M" under the first arrow and "× NA" under the second arrow in white chalk; students at desks copy it into their notebooks.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the chalk finishes the second arrow, and the students copy it down quickly, one nodding.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, singing, both forearms crossed in front of him in a calm X shape, a friendly smile, yellow light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he sings smoothly, holds the X shape for a moment, then slowly opens his arms wide.

shots.frame: Audience B-roll: rows of modern Taiwanese university students in the arena sway together with their phone lights raised high, some in white lab coats, smiling and singing along, warm sodium-yellow light washing over them.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the students sway slowly side to side with their phone lights in the air, smiling.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, holding up seven fingers (one open hand and two fingers) with a mocking frown, yellow light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, shows the seven fingers slowly, then shakes his head and gives a thumbs-down.

shots.frame: Reaction shot: John Dalton in cobalt-blue light keeps a stiff proud face, but the wooden ball in his hand trembles slightly, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, his proud face freezes, he grips the wooden ball tighter and glances away; his mouth stays closed.

shots.frame: Close-up: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, tapping his temple with one finger, a mocking grin, yellow rim light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, taps his temple twice slowly, then points across the stage.

shots.frame: Insert in a modern Taiwanese university classroom: a green chalkboard clearly shows three chemical formulas written one above another in white chalk - "CH2O", "C2H4O2", "C6H12O6" - and a big chalk bracket joining all three; a student in the front row frowns at it.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the student looks from one formula to the next and scratches her head; the camera pushes in slowly on the board.

shots.frame: Flashback, Karlsruhe 1860: a crowded assembly hall full of mid-19th-century chemists in dark frock coats and beards; at the front a young Italian chemist hands out small printed pamphlets to the eager crowd.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the pamphlets pass quickly from hand to hand, the chemists open them, read and turn to each other nodding in surprise.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, one hand raised high as if holding the top of a long unrolling scroll, a proud grin, yellow light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly draws his hand down from high to low as if unrolling a very long scroll, then bows slightly.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, holding up a shiny silver tablespoon in one hand, a confident grin, yellow light flaring behind him.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps harder, holds the tablespoon out toward the camera, then taps it twice on his palm.

shots.frame: Insert in a small modern Taiwanese dorm kitchen: a cup of instant noodles stands next to a small digital kitchen scale; on the scale a little white heap of table salt, the scale display clearly reads "4.6 g"; nobody in the shot.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, a pinch of salt sprinkles onto the heap and the camera pushes in slowly on the scale display.

shots.frame: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage, making a rectangle picture-frame shape with his thumbs and fingers in front of his face, a mocking smile, yellow light.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he raps, slowly moves the finger frame to the side as if hanging a picture on a wall, then drops his hands with a shrug.

shots.frame: Waist-up side-on two-shot, the two men stand close, about one metre apart, both faces large and visible in profile: Amedeo Avogadro on the RIGHT leans toward his rival and raises both hands overhead as if holding up a heavy roof beam; John Dalton on the LEFT faces him stiffly with arms crossed, mouth closed; cobalt-blue light left, sodium-yellow light right.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Avogadro raps at Dalton and slowly pushes both raised hands higher as if lifting a heavy beam; Dalton keeps his arms crossed and lips pressed together.
cons: John Dalton on the left keeps his lips pressed together from the first to the last frame; he never opens his mouth.

shots.frame: Reaction close-up: John Dalton in cobalt-blue light stares down at the wooden ball in his open palm, a shocked doubtful face, mouth closed.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he looks at the single wooden ball in his palm, slowly realises something, and closes his eyes in frustration; his mouth stays closed.

shots.frame: Close-up from the chest up: Amedeo Avogadro stands at the chrome microphone on the sodium-yellow right side of the stage leaning toward the camera with fierce triumphant eyes, one hand raised ready to point, the cobalt-blue and sodium-yellow arena softly blurred behind him.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he shouts the final line slowly, every word hit hard, and on the last word points straight at the camera.

shots.frame: Audience B-roll: the students in the arena explode with joy, jumping, screaming and throwing their chemistry notes into the air, confetti and sodium-yellow light raining over them.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the students jump, scream and throw papers into the air, confetti falling.

shots.frame: Two-shot on the stage: John Dalton on the LEFT and Amedeo Avogadro on the RIGHT stand side by side with arms crossed, both stubbornly looking away from each other, mouths closed; cobalt-blue light left, sodium-yellow light right.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, both men glance at each other at the same time, hold the look, and give each other one small reluctant nod; both mouths closed.

shots.frame: Humphry Davy behind his DJ booth faces the camera with both hands open palms-up as if asking the audience a question, a big playful grin, brass goggles on his forehead, the cheering student crowd and the cobalt-blue and sodium-yellow sides behind him.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, he shouts the questions to the camera, points at the viewer with both hands on the last words, then spreads his arms wide with a laugh.
